module.title: Diagnostic Units, Studies, Specialists and Prices
module.business_purpose: Gives a diagnostic unit a first-class identity, its own governance boundary, professionals, specialties, study catalog, public profile and versioned prices. Clinical results remain in diagnostics; this module describes the provider and the services it offers to patients, doctors and insurers.
